decisions.reason: As a schlager compilation CD it stays close to our established curation, label, and physical-distribution know-how, so we can keep learning from catalog sales and improve the offer rather than withdraw it quickly.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits especially well with our core reissue capabilities and collector-oriented customer base, giving us strong absorptive capacity to judge demand and sustain it.
The multi-disc box set is still related to our physical-edition strengths, but its higher production and inventory commitment makes it more exposed if demand softens, so we keep it with some caution.

Although the compilation CD is related to our existing offer, it appears less differentiated and strategically central, so the knowledge gains from keeping it are limited relative to using the resources for stronger catalog lines and new development.
